mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 PM, here is today's balanced dish: expect a comfortable 72 degrees at Verona Community Park under a waning crescent moon. The temperature will dip to an overnight low of 48 degrees, and you will be happy to know there is no rain in the forecast for tonight.

The City of Verona Common Council has unanimously adopted the Envision Verona Comprehensive Plan, which serves as a long-range guide for infrastructure, housing, and sustainable growth. Additionally, the city continues to emphasize community engagement with the upcoming implementation phase known as Ready, Set, Go.

We have a busy schedule today with Live Music at Paddy Mac's, Yoga at Insight Wellness, the Downtown Farmer's Market, Pizza and a Pitcher at Lake Lou-ee, and Trivia Night at The Bogey Factory. Looking ahead, you can check out ART House 360 or Hop Haus Trivia tomorrow.
In our weekly look at service calls, on October 3, police responded to a stolen firearm case where an officer successfully located and arrested a 19-year-old man in possession of the weapon.
Stop by for a scoop of today's flavor, Turtle Cheesecake. The store is currently open and will remain ready to serve you until 10:00 PM tonight.
